item_gap_accounting.center_definition: subtract random-category-exposure-share-weighted category mean from both the estimate and randomized reference; report unweighted MAE across categories
item_gap_accounting.definition: symmetric within-category video residual and exposure-mix identity (the legacy response_context key denotes the within-video residual); two-player Shapley values allocate absolute gap after the identity, before and after fixed random-share centering
